items.name: TestSprite 4.0
items.tagline: Fix one thing, break another? This agent checks it all
items.description: Your coding agent fixes one thing and breaks another. TestSprite 4.0 is a brand-new testing agent that remembers what your app should do and checks all of it, every time. Tell it in plain words what to test. It explores your running app, writes and runs the end-to-end tests, tells you which failures are real bugs, and keeps checking every change from the web, your terminal or your pull requests.

items.name: Verse Engine by Ctruh
items.tagline: Blender, Unity or Unreal to a live 3D link in one click
items.description: Verse Engine by Ctruh is a browser-native 3D and XR engine that turns any 3D into one link. Bring files, scans and floor plans, or publish straight from Blender, Unity and Unreal. The link opens in any browser with no app and no download. Built for developers, 3D artists, game studios, architects, real estate teams and e-commerce brands. A scene streams only what the viewer sees, so a 10.3 billion triangle city opens from a link on a laptop. Embeds, API and SDK included. Free 14-day Pro trial.

items.name: Netlify Server
items.tagline: Run WebSockets, multiplayer apps, and long-running agents
items.description: Netlify Server gives your app a backend that stays alive while people are using it. Build realtime experiences, multiplayer games, and AI agents that need time to finish. Describe what you want and an agent builds it, or bring your Express, Fastify, Hono, or Koa code. It holds WebSockets open, keeps state in memory, and deploys with the rest of your project, with its own server for every preview. Scales with demand and down to zero when idle. Free during early access.

items.name: Stripo Email Widgets
items.tagline: Put a game, quiz or survey in your next email. No coding
items.description: Put a scratch card, quiz, poll, NPS survey or event agenda into your email. Drag a widget into the Stripo editor, then tell the AI Assistant what to change: text, colors, questions, prizes. Each of the 20+ widgets comes with its design, interaction and fallback logic built in. It plays where the inbox supports interactivity and shows a clean static block where it doesn't. Save the container and reuse it in any template. Available on every plan, including Free.

items.name: Spellar for Chrome
items.tagline: Free, no-bot meeting notes with memory, now in your browser
items.description: Spellar for Chrome takes no-bot meeting notes on Windows and Mac, right in your browser, with no desktop app to install. It records Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex, and nothing joins the call. On Google Meet, transcripts show real speaker names. Every call goes into one memory with your Spellar Mac and iPhone notes, so you can ask what a client said three calls ago. Send notes to Slack or Notion and pick Claude, GPT or Gemini. Start with 300 free minutes, no card needed.

items.name: Adside
items.tagline: A team of specialized AI agents that manage paid ads for you
items.description: A team of specialized AI agents that manage your paid ads on Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter. Run it yourself, or have one of our human experts manage it for you.

items.name: Tabstack by Mozilla
items.tagline: Give your model the web without giving up your privacy
items.description: Research, extract, and automate the web from one managed API. Get a cited answer, clean text, matching JSON, or a completed browser task from the live web in one call. We run the browsers and the web loop outside your model, so you build your agent without building its web stack. Never trained on. Private by default. Built by Mozilla. Start free with 10,000 credits.

items.name: Manufact
items.tagline: Ship and test your MCP to every plugin marketplace
items.description: Manufact helps teams publish MCP servers and plugins, understand how agents use them, and test releases across clients. Bring publishing checks, session traces and cross-client tests into one workflow.

items.name: Teaflask
items.tagline: Self-improving AI copilot for your app. No backend changes.
items.description: Turn your existing SaaS into an AI-native product without rebuilding your backend. Teaflask adds a managed AI copilot that lets users get things done by simply asking. Integrate through your frontend, use your own UI components, and go live in a day. Teaflask keeps its product knowledge grounded in your code, learns from real usage, and lets you test changes before release.

items.name: Gemini 4 Neon
items.tagline: Frontier reasoning with faster task completion
items.description: Gemini 4 Neon brings frontier-level reasoning to faster coding, research, and agent workflows. Adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon, it supports multimodal inputs and a 1M-token context window, with access through the Gemini API, AI Studio, and Antigravity.

items.name: Wispr Flow Notetaker for iPhone
items.tagline: Free AI meeting notes, wherever work takes you
items.description: Wispr Flow Notetaker is now on iPhone. Capture in-person meetings on your phone and virtual meetings on desktop, for free. All your notes stay together across devices, so you can pick up right where you left off.

items.name: Cleared
items.tagline: Your personal plan to give up vapes, pouches and cigarettes
items.description: Most people who quit nicotine try without a plan. Cleared builds one from what you use, then helps every day: a check-in, a daily coach, one-tap logging and Craving SOS for the hard moments. Took a home nicotine test? Snap a photo and AI reads the result.

items.name: Enrichable by Context.dev
items.tagline: Open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment
items.description: Free, open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment. Build lead lists from a prompt, research every row with live web data, and find work emails.

items.name: ToolJet
items.tagline: Vibe-coded business apps that pass the security review
items.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor build your internal tools in React. ToolJet is the platform underneath: 100+ data integrations, a built-in database, permissions, security scans on every save, version reviews, and workflows with human approvals.

items.name: Meilisearch Searchandising
items.tagline: Pin, boost, hide and personalize search results
items.description: New in Meilisearch Cloud: search rules and personalization. Build rules in a visual editor: drag a product to the top, boost or deboost by any filter, and hide what you don’t want to sell. Trigger rules on specific searches, category pages or every query, and schedule them for campaigns like Black Friday. Compare results with and without a rule before it goes live, no deploy needed. Personalization reranks results per user (experimental, on request). Same rules via the API, 3 free per project.

items.name: mio click
items.tagline: A fidget that's also a friend
items.description: mio click is a handheld clicker with one mechanical button and a tiny screen. Hatch a Squig, Goober or Meatball. No two are the same, and yours moves every time you press. It counts every click anywhere you take it, then syncs over Wi-Fi to a public leaderboard where you can see how your mio ranks, hatch a new one or swap with a friend. Assembled by hand in small batches by a team of parents. The button is rated for 50 million clicks.

items.name: Impractical
items.tagline: Make launch videos in the style of Framer, Notion, and more
items.description: Pick a video template you like and make it about your product. Add your UI, copy and brand, then tell the AI what to change. Impractical helps founders and marketers make launch videos, feature announcements and explainers without building every video from scratch. Get started for free at impractical.ai! PS: If you're planning on doing your own launch, need a video, and don't know where to start, reach out! We're happy to directly work with startups to get them kickass videos with Impractical.

items.name: HeyGen Avatar 6
items.tagline: AI Avatar Model That Looks Like You
items.description: Avatar 6 is HeyGen’s most realistic AI avatar model, 84.4% indistinguishable from real footage. Your first video is free.

items.name: Room AI
items.tagline: Talk to it like a designer. Your room, one change at a time
items.description: Upload a photo of your room and say what you'd change. Each reply is a new photo of your room with that change made and the rest left as it was. Every version kept, compare any two. No credits to count. Try it on your room first, no card.

items.name: Fieldwork Code
items.tagline: AI coding on your laptop or in the cloud, from your phone
items.description: Run parallel AI coding sessions with your choice of harness (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi or Fieldwork's own) and model, locally via our desktop app (free) or in cloud sandboxes ($50/mo). Pick up any session from the web or the Fieldwork mobile app. A side pane gives you a terminal, file diffs, PR status and CI checks, plus one-click instructions and inline diff reviews for your agent. Built on Fieldwork, so it comes with 3,000+ connectors, tasks and a knowledge base.
